holiday_date_checks.description: Dr. Baba Saheb Ambedkar Jayanti/ Mahavir Jayanti

interpretation: This is a diagnostic comparison only. A circular holiday absent from TRI is consistent with a closure but does not prove the entire calendar is complete. A TRI observation on a circular holiday requires session-type review. Unexplained weekdays may be missing data, ad-hoc closures, or other exchange events and must not be auto-classified.
